admission.workflow: Present one xterm-backed Candidate terminal connected only to one server-authorized remote PTY after current Workspace acknowledgement and independent security gating.

items.rationale: Canonical Microsoft MIT text for the reviewed VS Code terminal evidence.
Retain explicit terminal dimensions, lifecycle concepts and data contracts while replacing local process/profile authority with one closed remote PTY protocol.
Retain ordered output delivery and acknowledgement pressure, with strict sequence gaps and a bounded unacknowledged-byte window replacing timer-based local-process batching.
Retain one explicit instance lifecycle, xterm write acknowledgement, resize, input, focus, accessibility and disposal through a Proctor-owned remote-only panel.
Use the same mature emulator family with screen-reader mode, token theme, device-pixel-ratio-aware measurement and bounded scrollback rather than implementing a lesser escape parser.

Local shell profiles, extension contributions, tabs, splits, tasks, persistent processes, reconnection and environment-variable collections would expand the product beyond one server-authorized remote PTY.

dependencies.rationale: The exact xterm generation declared by the pinned VS Code source provides mature terminal emulation and accessibility behavior.
Current Workspace persistence is acknowledged before the PTY may open against current content.
The Exam Security Coordinator supplies independent pause, posture, connection and Participation gates without entering the renderer.

divergences.summary: One server-authorized PTY replaces all local shell, process, profile, task, split and persistent-session capabilities.
An open may require acknowledged current Workspace content and every privileged frame is fenced to exact connection and Participation generations.
Transport loss, gaps, overflow and stale scope fail closed; first release has no Desktop PTY replay or resurrection.

The pinned xterm package keeps its complete required DOM styles inside the terminal contribution's cascade ownership, including its documented dim compatibility override, and follows live workbench theme, forced-color and reduced-motion state.

verification.obligation: Verify Workspace acknowledgement, independent gates, exact scope, ordering, backpressure, bounds, stale generation, exit and renderer protocol closure.
Verify the real sandboxed Chromium xterm surface, accessible prompt, live theme and reduced-motion presentation, measured resize, selector-fenced write acknowledgement, closed actions and disposal.
Verify layer direction, runtime placement, static Candidate contribution, preload closure, cycle absence, contribution-scoped CSS and the exact reviewed xterm compatibility override.
Verify reviewed terminal evidence against the exact pinned VS Code revision.
